pieces.name: main
pieces.notes: Main E-W (rotated) hip; dark north face meets ridge about 100 px south of the north eave; south face long and bright. SE corner of the plan is cut at 45 deg (excluded). SW part is under tree shadow but is roof.

pieces.name: south_wing
pieces.notes: Possible south wing with ridge along v (brightness step at u about 65 near the south eave). Overlaps main; medium-low confidence.

pieces.name: garage
pieces.notes: West wing (garage side, cars parked west of it). Dark north face, ridge about v=-50, lit south face; valleys into main north face.

notes: Rotated (about 24 deg) single-story hip home. Sun from SW (ground shadow is navy B-R 65+ north and east of the house). Three regions: main hip, west garage wing, probable south wing. Confidence medium: south wing existence is the main doubt; SE 45-deg cut is clear.
